mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, furigana, age, gender, nickname, email, city, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{furigana}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{city}, #{remark})
INSERT INTO students_courses (student_id, course_name, completion_date, remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{completionDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, furigana = #{furigana}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, city = #{city}, remark = #{remark}, isDeleted = #{deleted} WHERE id = #{id}
